Alright, let me think about this year.

My 5 mu is all wheat-maize, same as always. With six mouths to feed and some of the kids working off-farm now, I can't take big chances. The wheat I planted last October is already in the ground — now I'm thinking about how to manage it through spring, and then getting the maize in right after the June harvest.

**Wheat (already planted last October, harvesting this June)**

I put down about 25 kg of compound fertilizer (15-15-15) per mu as base fertilizer before planting, like I always do. That gives around 4 kg N, 4 kg P, 4 kg K per mu at the base. Now in spring I need to topdress urea at jointing — I usually do about 20 kg urea per mu, which is about 9 kg of N. The extension guy at the township station told me I could get away with 15 kg of urea if I split it, but honestly I've tried cutting back before and the wheat looked pale, so I stick with what works. Total N ends up around 13 kg/mu.

Irrigation — I already gave it the winter water in December. I'll irrigate again at jointing in March when I topdress (the water helps the fertilizer move down), and one more at grain filling in May if it's dry. Three times total, which is pretty normal around here. Pumping costs money — maybe 30-40 yuan per mu each time from the tube well.

For pests, I'll spray once for aphids in April, and if I see stripe rust I'll add a fungicide. I bought the sprayer myself years ago so just the chemical cost.

Last year I got about 450 kg/mu. This year I'm hoping for similar — around 2200 kg total from the 5 mu. We keep some for flour, sell the rest.

**Maize (planting mid-June right after wheat)**

Tight window between wheat combine and maize planting — maybe 5-7 days. I use a no-till planter (hire it, about 25 yuan/mu) that goes right into the wheat stubble. Saves a turnaround. Hybrid seed, Zhengdan or Denghai variety, whatever the agri-supply store has at a decent price — about 40 yuan/mu for seed.

For maize I don't put much base fertilizer — just throw some compound down with the planter, maybe 15 kg/mu. Then I topdress urea at the big flare stage (6-8 leaf), around 25 kg urea per mu. That gets me about 13-14 kg N/mu total. Phosphorus and potassium from the compound at base.

Irrigation — summer rains usually cover most of it. I'll irrigate once at planting if it's dry, and once at tasseling if July is hot with no rain. Usually 1-2 times.

Spray herbicide (atrazine mix) after planting. Maybe a pyrethroid for borer later if I see it. 

Last year maize gave me around 500 kg/mu. Similar hope this year.

**Labor**

The wife and I do most of the field work. My eldest son works in town and comes back for harvest week. Daughter-in-law helps with weeding. Maybe 25-30 family labor-days total across both crops. I hire the combine harvester for wheat (about 50 yuan/mu) and the maize harvester in fall — can't do it all by hand anymore at my age.
